CustomField.description: Where the home page card's headline number is computed from when the card loads. Blank means the stored Headline Metric text is shown as it is. When a source is set, the first number in Headline Metric is replaced by the computed one and the {n} token in Headline Metric Label is filled. The stored text stays as the fallback when the source cannot be read.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the live source for this card's number, or leave blank to show the stored text. Keep a number in Headline Metric as the fallback. The label may hold {n} for the number, and {coverage} for the org coverage when the source is Apex tests.
CustomField.label: Headline Metric Source
